comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: LAYER 2 CRATE-LEVEL MODULE MAP (the design act). Home: vsdd-core beside Layer 1. NEW MODULES: (1) snapshot/ — mod.rs the Snapshot struct mirroring snapshot-schema's snapshot_fields verbatim (acquisition_outcome enum acquired|absent|unusable; milestones, findings, round_manifests, round_children, comment_handles, the four display fields); acquire.rs the EFFECTFUL acquisition building the snapshot from the chassis's query surface — one acquisition per invocation, absent and unusable outcomes never panic (the count-conduct instruments join at Layer 3). (2) answer/ — mod.rs the PhaseAnswer struct (phase, layer, next_action from the vocabulary, active composition echo, degraded kind, integrity findings at the kind-set grain); derive.rs the PURE derivation (State, Snapshot, the loaded registry data) -> PhaseAnswer — deterministic, degraded exactly when the outcome is absent or unusable with the kind never swapped, null phase mapping to the enter action, fix-lane tokens excluded from the output domain per the #689 ruling; integrity.rs the PURE snapshot-scoped checks, the audit's six less the degraded-kind check (which is the derivation's own enforced property): round-parity, unresolvable handles, findings missing owner or validator, closed findings missing evidence, phase pointer against milestone state. (3) integrity_shell/ — refs.rs the off-grammar query: a PURE membership core over injected ref names consuming the registered branch grammar (both forms plus exempt refs), the git listing in the shell; substrate.rs the session-substrate check over the installed-artifact manifest — three-valued fail-closed per entry by its resolution field, plus the project-root-equals-repo-root member. PURITY: derive, integrity, and refs membership are pure property targets; acquisition, git listing, and filesystem resolution are shell. DEPENDENCY, PE-FLAGGED: the regex crate — the branch grammar's registered patterns are regex strings in versioned data, and hand-rolling a matcher would reimplement what the data declares; investigation note follows with the suite. DATA-SHAPE PREREQUISITE, found by this design act: dispatch-data's exempt refs live in rules PROSE while this layer's refs query consumes them as data — the #688-adopted set promotes to a structured exempt_refs field under the pair rule (data-side mechanical, the adopted content unchanged), and sets.rs types branch_grammar per its Layer 2 deepening annotation. ORACLE TERRITORY AHEAD: the convergence fixtures' reference answers draft with the suite and are proposals until operator adoption.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DESIGN NOTE for Layer 3's entry (operator question 2026-07-22, Thermite-informed): POSITION AND HEALTH ARE ORTHOGONAL FACETS of the one derived output — position (phase, layer, next action, composition; boundary-cadence, navigational) versus health (degraded kind, integrity, substrate, refs; continuous-cadence, diagnostic); a disagreeing snapshot filing a finding without degrading already encodes the split. SURFACING MODEL, the Thermite lesson (thermite-state-architecture knowledge page): silence when healthy at act time (hooks block, never narrate); position plus health COUNTS ONLY in the always-on session-start slice, inside the existing always-on-core 1500-token budget; full health detail is PULL (the status forms), fetched when counts are nonzero; the statusline stays position-glance plus one health word (already designed). STRUCTURAL CONSEQUENCE, deliberately deferred: the PhaseAnswer struct stays flat (no fixture churn pre-adoption); the split lands at Layer 3 as NAMED BLOCKS in the machine form — answer (position) and report (health) — two sections in the human form, and the session-start slice specified position-plus-counts under budget. The health-detail-is-pull rule is the token-economics guard: health detail scales with estate mess and ambient surfaces must not. One acquisition, one derivation, two named facets, four channels by cadence.
